exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) status (diagnosed by old WHO criteria vs. IADPSG criteria)
cohort: The study participants were 2,405 pregnant women who delivered between January 2009 and December 2010.
finding: The IADPSG diagnostic criteria identified a higher prevalence of GDM, and women diagnosed with GDM by IADPSG but not WHO criteria experienced adverse pregnancy outcomes including higher rates of fetal macrosomia, LGA, and pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean section was significantly higher in pregnant women with GDM compared to the control group.
